headline: Gameplay & Software Developer
profile: Gameplay and software developer working across Unity/C#, Unreal Engine/C++, and web and mobile applications. My experience combines gameplay programming for PC and mobile, full-stack development, multidisciplinary game projects, and leadership of a five-person indie team. I build reusable mechanics, developer tools, UI systems, and the data flows that connect them.

experience.role: Team Lead · Producer, Lead Developer & Game Designer
points: Lead a five-person indie team, coordinating technical development, production priorities, and creative direction.
Build the game's technical and design foundation, including custom gameplay systems, UI architecture, dialogue, and event-data pipelines.
Combine hands-on programming with game design and oversight of the team's code and overall project direction.

experience.context: Collaborative game projects and game jams
points: Contributed to more than nine international game and game-jam projects as a core gameplay developer.
Implemented modular gameplay loops, developer tools, and UI systems in Unity and C#.
Worked with multidisciplinary teams through code reviews and sprint planning, contributing to games published on Futuregames' itch.io page.

Collaborated in Agile sprints with a team of more than five developers, using Git and Trello.
